data.title: Contagion Range

data.title: Afflicted
data.text: During the Declare Battle Formations step, select one of the Plagues below. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit, and that unit has the effect of your chosen Plague.

data.title: Skullsquirm Blight
data.text:
Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, enemy units have the benefit of cover against that attack.
Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

data.title: Rattlejoint Ague
data.text: Worsen the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.

data.title: Scabrous Soulrot
data.text: Worsen the Move, Leadership, and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1 (this rule can only worsen a model’s Objective Control characteristic to a minimum of 1).

data.title: Pact of Decay
data.text: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select PLAGUE LEGIONS as your Army Faction.

data.title: Worldblight
data.text: At the end of your Command phase, if a friendly DEATH GUARD unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured. Until you lose control of that objective, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective, that enemy unit is Afflicted (pg 71).

data.title: Daemon Weapon of Nurgle
data.text: DEATH GUARD model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

data.title: Furnace of Plagues
data.text: DEATH GUARD model only. Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearers melee weapons, and the bearer’s melee weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

data.title: Arch Contaminator
data.text: DEATH GUARD model only. While the bearer’s unit is within range of an objective marker you control, each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

data.title: Revolting Regeneration
data.text: DEATH GUARD model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

data.title: PUTRID DETONATION
data.flavor: Bloated with putrefaction and swilling with infectious poisons, the demise of this hulking entity is as revolting as it is explosively hazardous.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.

data.title: DISGUSTINGLY RESILIENT
data.flavor: Those favoured by Nurgle are inured to pain, their rotting bodies shrugging off all but the most traumatic damage with ease.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

data.title: PLAGUESURGE
data.flavor: The foul miasma around the Death Guard swells and thickens, boiling outward like putrid smog.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.

data.title: LEECHSPORE ERUPTION
data.flavor: Billowing from this warrior's wounds come clouds of parasitic spores that settle on the foe and drain their vitality, stealing it for the one who spawned them.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD model your army that has lost one or more wounds.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).

data.title: OVERWHELMING GENEROSITY
data.flavor: Unholy filth gushes from Nurgle's faithful into their guns until the armaments threaten to burst like bloated corpses.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Start of your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.

data.title: CREEPING BLIGHT
data.flavor: Those in the grip of Nurgle's unholy plagues become weaker by the moment, barely able to lift their weapons, let alone defend themselves from the attacking Death Guard.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

data.title: Numberless Horde
data.text:
In your Command phase in each of the following battle rounds, depending on your chosen battle size, add a new POXWALKERS unit with a Starting Strength of 10 to your army, in Strategic Reserves.
BATTLE SIZEBATTLE ROUNDSIncursion2,3Strike Force2, 3, 4Onslaught2, 3, 4, 5
KEYWORDS
POXWALKERS units from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

data.title: Witherbone Pipes
data.text: NOXIOUS BLIGHTBRINGER only. While the bearer is leading a POXWALKERS unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, and each time that unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, add 1 to that test.

data.title: Lord of the Walking Pox
data.text: DEATH GUARD model only. If the bearer is leading a POXWALKER unit, and is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round as the third battle round.

data.title: Sorrowsyphon
data.text: MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only. While the bearer is leading a POXWALKERS unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s Plague Wind weapon. Each time the bearer makes one or more attacks with a Plague Wind weapon, after the bearer’s unit has resolved its attacks, D3 Bodyguard models from the bearer’s unit are destroyed.

data.title: Talisman of Burgeoning
data.text: DEATH GUARD model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of POXWALKERS models in that unit.

data.title: GRIP OF THE WALKING POX
data.flavor: Those infected by walking pox may fall as though fatally wounded, but they soon rise again.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: After the attacking unit has fought, roll one D6 for each model from your unit that was destroyed as a result of those attacks: on a 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If your unit is not destroyed after the attacking unit has fought, enemy models destroyed as a result of this Stratagem count as enemy models destroyed by an attack made by a model in your unit for the purposes of the Curse of the Walking Pox ability.

data.title: SMEARED WITH FILTH
data.flavor: Hacking a path through a horde of Poxwalkers leaves aggressors coated in infectious matter.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one enemy unit that made one or more attacks that targeted your unit this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is Afflicted.

data.title: GNAWING HUNGER
data.flavor: Gripped by a sudden, monstrous hunger, the Poxwalkers surge forward in a ravenous mass.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One POXWALKERS unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

data.title: HIDDEN AMONGST THE DEAD
data.flavor: Another wave of Poxwalkers rises from the battlefield’s carrion heaps.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: The Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One POXWALKERS unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves and that is not an Attached unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.

data.title: SHOCK AND HORROR
data.flavor: Already dismayed by this living nightmare, the enemy falters before another sudden onslaught.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Charge phase, just after a DEATH GUARD unit from your army ends a Charge move.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That DEATH GUARD unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

data.title: SHAMBLING WALL
data.flavor: Lacking even basic self-preservation instincts, Poxwalkers make excellent walking shields.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly POXWALKERS unit within 3" of your unit and visible to both your unit and the attacking unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your DEATH GUARD unit, if your POXWALKERS unit is visible to the attacking model and is an eligible target for that attack, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead a number of POXWALKERS from your POXWALKERS unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack are destroyed.

data.title: Reverberant Rancidity
data.text:
While a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army is within 7" of one or more DEATH GUARD units from your army, that PLAGUE LEGIONS unit has the Nurgle’s Gift ability.
While a DEATH GUARD unit from your army is within 7" of one or more PLAGUE LEGIONS units from your army, add 3" to that DEATH GUARD units Contagion Range.
PLAGUE LEGIONS
You can include PLAGUE LEGIONS units in your army, even though they do not have the DEATH GUARD Faction keyword. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is:
- Incursion: Up to 500 pts
- Strike Force: Up to 1000 pts
- Onslaught: Up to 1500 pts
No PLAGUE LEGIONS models from your army can be your WARLORD.

data.title: Beckoning Blight
data.text: DEATH GUARD model only. Each time a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is set up wholly within 12" of the bearer, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models, instead of more than 8".

data.title: Fell Harvester
data.text: DEATH GUARD model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

data.title: Entropic Knell
data.text: GREAT UNCLEAN ONE only. In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of the bearer that is below its Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

data.title: Tome of Bounteous Blessings
data.text: MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only. Each time a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit within 12" of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test, add 1 to that test and, if that test is passed, one model in that unit regains up to D3 lost wounds (if that unit is a BATTLELINE unit and that test is passed, up to D3 destroyed models can be returned to that unit instead).

data.title: PERSISTENT PESTS
data.flavor: There is no simple way to wholly cleanse a Nurgling infestation once it has taken root.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Any phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One NURGLINGS unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with its full wounds remaining.

lines.label: RESTRICTIONS

lines.label: TARGET

lines.text: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

data.title: SIGNAL POX
data.category: Death Lord’s Chosen – Epic Deed Stratagem
data.flavor: Guided in by rasping jets of fumes sent up by this Lord of Virulence, plague-ridden artillery fire and airbursting spore-shells saturate the target zone.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One LORD OF VIRULENCE model from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one objective marker within 30" of and visible to your model. Until the start of your next turn, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective marker, that unit is Afflicted.

data.title: MORTARION'S TEACHINGS
data.category: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
data.flavor: Exemplifying the Daemon Primarch's doctrines on versatile heavy infantry tactics, these warriors position themselves and let fly.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [HEAVY] abilities.

data.title: SICKENING IMPACT
data.category: Death Lord’s Chosen – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
data.flavor: Employing their crushing bulk and contagious gifts, these Terminators slam into their victims and grind them into putrefying mulch.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Charge phase, just after a TERMINATOR unit from your army ends a Charge move.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That TERMINATOR unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

data.title: Miasmic Bombardment
data.text:
At the start of the battle round, select a number of enemy units more than 12" away from every model from your army that is on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle round, those enemy units are Afflicted. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.
BATTLE SIZEUNITSIncursion1Strike Force2Onslaught3

data.title: Eye of Affliction
data.text: DEATH GUARD model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [ignores cover] ability while targeting an Afflicted enemy unit.

data.title: Bilemaw Blight
data.text: MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only. At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, add 12" to the Range characteristics of the bearer’s Plague Wind weapon.

data.title: Shriekworm Familiar
data.text: DEATH GUARD model only. Once per battle round, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP.

data.title: Tendrilous Emissions
data.text: LORD OF VIRULENCE only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly DEATH GUARD VEHICLE units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability, and each time one of those VEHICLE units makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit visible to the bearer, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

data.title: BLIGHTED LAND
data.flavor: Firing diseased submunitions or belching swarms of daemonic parasites from its hull, this war engine befouls the battlefield as it advances.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: End of your Movement phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one terrain feature within 24" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units are Afflicted while they are within 3" of that terrain feature.

data.title: RELENTLESS GRIND
data.flavor: When the armoured vehicles of the Death Guard advance, they plough through - or straight over- anything that stands in their way.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

data.title: DRAWN TO DESPAIR
data.flavor: Those who languish in misery or cower in terror make themselves easy targets for the Death Guard.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT) within your opponent’s deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

data.title: FONT OF FILTH
data.flavor: As though afflicted with some awful vomiting sickness, this vehicle's weapons retch an endless stream of fire at the enemy, heaving themselves empty even as it storms into the enemy lines.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

data.title: EYESTINGER STORM
data.flavor: Swarms of these revolting insects burrow hives into the hulls of Death Guard vehicles. Drawn to sickened prey, they boil forth in buzzing masses and descend on the foe, spreading panic and horror.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit from your army.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one objective marker visible to one or more models in your unit. Each Afflicted enemy unit within range of that objective marker must take a Battle-shock test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

data.title: STINKING MIRE
data.flavor: Attempting to counterattack Death Guard can leave foes floundering amidst bubbling filth.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One friendly unengaged DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

data.title: Manifold Maladies
data.text: At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the Plagues listed in Nurgle’s Gift. Until the end of the battle, that is your chosen Plague instead of any previously chosen Plague.

data.title: Final Ingredient
data.text: BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER only. Once per battle, after the bearers unit has fought, if one or more CHARACTER models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is Afflicted, that unit has the effect of the selected Plague in addition to any other.

data.title: Visions of Virulence
data.text: MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only. While an enemy unit is enfeebled by the bearer’s Pestilent Fallout ability, that unit is also Afflicted.

data.title: Needle of Nurgle
data.text: PLAGUE SURGEON only. Each time the bearer uses its Tainted Narthecium ability, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer’s unit (instead of 1).

data.title: Cornucophagus
data.text: LORD OF POXES only. In the Declare Battle Formations step select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of the bearer, that enemy unit has the effect of that Plague in addition to any other.

data.title: BLESSINGS OF FILTH
data.category: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
data.flavor: Employing their unique gifts, this champion enhances the weapons of their comrades with even greater levels of infectious malevolence.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

data.title: MALIGNANCE MAGNIFIED
data.category: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
data.flavor: The vile talents of such plague specialists act like a filth-smeared lens, focusing and intensifying the infectious gifts of Nurgle.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

data.title: GROTESQUE FORTITUDE
data.category: Champions of Contagion – Battle Tactic Stratagem
data.flavor: After their champion calls down the blessings of Nurgle, these warriors can fight on no matter the catastrophic, often gruesome, damage done to them by the foe.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD Attached unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit.

data.title: RABID INFUSION
data.category: Champions of Contagion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
data.flavor: The combined talents of these Death Guard champions drive their followers into a foam-jawed fury, be it through injection with a curdled cocktail of stimms or immersion in a fug of infectious agents.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Start of the Fight phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD unit from your army that includes two CHARACTER models.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Fights First ability.

data.title: MOBILE VECTOR
data.category: Champions of Contagion – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
data.flavor: Nurgle's champions move through the Death Guard ranks like squirming parasites.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army that is not leading a unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one other friendly DEATH GUARD unit (excluding Battle-shocked units and Attached units that already have two Leader units or one of your CHARACTER units leading it] within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your unit that your unit can lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet]. Your unit attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.

data.title: DEATH’S HEADS
data.flavor: It takes much effort and sacrifice to fashion the disgusting explosives known as death's heads, but the results are spectacularly horrible.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) that is within 8" of and visible to your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the effect of all Plagues (see Nurgle’s Gift).

data.title: Hypervirulent Strains
data.text: Friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER units have +3" to their Contagion Range (to a maximum of 12").

data.title: Rejuvenating Swarm
data.text: DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only (excluding TERMINATOR models). Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

data.title: Host of the Hybridised Pox
data.text: DEATH GUARD INFANTRY model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one of the Plagues listed in Nurgle’s Gift (see Codex: Death Guard). Enemy units within Contagion Range of this unit also have the effect of that Plague in addition to your army’s chosen Plague until the end of the battle.

data.title: TERRITORIAL INFECTION
data.flavor: The intensive contagions that flow in abundance from this champion taint everything around them, making taking ground from them a repulsive prospect for the enemy.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Start of the Command phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

data.title: AGGRAVUS SPASMS
data.flavor: There is no hiding from contagion, and particular pathogens can incite neurological paroxysms that force their victims to give away their positions in painful throes.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Start of your Shooting Phase.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one visible enemy unit within Contagion Range of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.

data.title: SIMULTANEOUS CONTAMINATION
data.flavor: The worst infections spread both visibly and subtly. Thus do the Death Guard’s champions attack, ordering vile operations, the two vectors more deadly than either alone.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit starts an action.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: That action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

data.title: Warped and Rusted Animus
data.text:
- Friendly FOETID BLOAT-DRONE/FOETID BLOAT-DRONE WITH HEAVY BLIGHT LAUNCHER/HELBRUTE/MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER units have CONTAGION ENGINE.
- Friendly CONTAGION ENGINE units’ ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
This detachment has the ENGINES tag and cannot be taken with another ENGINES detachment.

data.title: Parasitic Woe‑Reaper
data.text: CONTAGION ENGINE unit only. When this unit has fought, one model in this unit heals D3 wounds.

data.title: Lancet of the Worldsore
data.text: Friendly HELBRUTE/MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER unit only. This unit has MOBILE.

data.title: FRESH VECTORS
data.flavor: As if drawn to flesh and matter yet to be blessed by corruption, infected weapons unerringly find their mark.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to attack.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

data.title: BLOODRUST DELUGE
data.flavor: Warp‑tainted saturation oozes through this aggressive vehicle, leeching into its weapons, which spit the infection into foes at a distance.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit is selected to shoot.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one visible enemy unit. That enemy unit is Afflicted until your unit has attacked.

data.title: SOULROT FLUX
data.flavor: As courage crumbles in the face of mechanised abhorrence, then does the bloom of soulrot find purchase to spread its cyclic infection.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly CONTAGION ENGINE unit.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That CONTAGION ENGINE unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, roll one D6: - On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. - On a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. - On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

data.title: Verminous Haze
data.text:
In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to two friendly PLAGUE MARINES units. Those units have Infiltrators.
This detachment has the FLYBLOWN tag and cannot be taken with another FLYBLOWN detachment.

data.title: Insectile Murmuration
data.text: PLAGUE MARINES unit only. When this unit’s attacks target a unit within Contagion Range of a friendly unit, those attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

data.title: Plagueveil
data.text: PLAGUE MARINES unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

data.title: NAUSEATING PAROXYSMS
data.flavor: The contagion borne by the Death Guard and their attendant swarms of winged vermin triggers bouts of sickness and convulsion in those they encounter.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Start of the Fight phase

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: One friendly engaged PLAGUE MARINES unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

data.title: DRONING HORROR
data.flavor: Clouds of droning daemon flies sweep across the battlefield to envelop the enemies of the Death Guard. As their victims claw and scratch at the seething swarms, Mortarion’s sons pick off their targets at leisure.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That PLAGUE MARINES unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s ranged attacks: - Can re-roll hit rolls of 1. - That target a unit within half range, can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

data.title: EYE OF THE SWARM
data.flavor: The vermin swarms intensify as the Death Guard close in upon the enemy. As their foes clutch and tear their crawling skin, pitiless Plague Marines unleash volleys of point‑blank fire into their tormented foes.

lines.label: WHEN
lines.text: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PLAGUE MARINES unit is selected to shoot.

lines.label: TARGET
lines.text: That PLAGUE MARINES unit.

lines.label: EFFECT
lines.text: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [CLOSE-QUARTERS].

data.title: Nurgle's Gift, Contagion Range Section
data.text: Add 'Contagion Range cannot be greater than 12" after modifiers.'

data.title: Nurgle's Gift, Skullsquirm Blight
data.text:
Change to:
‘• Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, enemy units have the benefit of cover against that attack.
• Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.’

data.title: Virulent Vectorium Detachment, Worldblight Detachment Rule
data.text:
Change to:
'At the end of your Command phase, if a friendly DEATH GUARD unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured. Until you lose control of that objective, while an enemy unit is within range of that objective, that enemy unit is Afflicted.'

data.title: Tallyband Summoners Detachment, Beckoning Blight Enhancement
data.text:
Change to:
‘DEATH GUARD model only. Each time a PLAGUE LEGIONS unit from your army is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is set up wholly within 12" of the bearer, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models, instead of more than 8".’

clauses.text: Below you will find several DEATH GUARD Detachments you can select from to use in games of Warhammer 40,000, as described in the Core Rules (see the Select Detachment Rules step).
The Detachment rule listed here will apply to either your whole army or to particular units within it.
This can include units your army either must include or cannot include, as well as additional keywords some of your units may gain.
When mustering your army, your chosen Detachment enables you to upgrade CHARACTERS using the Enhancements listed here, as described in the Core Rules (see the Select Units step).
Your chosen Detachment gives you access to the Stratagems listed here in addition to the Core Stratagems listed in the Core Rules.
During the battle, you can spend Command points (CP) to use these Stratagems.
